reels.title: M20 DIVAR
reels.caption:
You don't have no time. You have 4 hours a night on your phone. 🧱

Day 1, same evening. One lays a brick. One opens his phone. Day 30, the wall falls. He starts again. A year later, one built something. The other scrolled 1,460 hours.

Same evenings. Different year.

Send this to someone who says they have no time.

#discipline #screentime #selfimprovement #motivation #habits

reels.title: M21 ZENGLI SAAT
reels.caption:
The alarm rings for everyone. Not everyone gets up. ⏰

Day 1, same alarm. One gets up and runs. One hits snooze. Day 30, he falls. He gets back up. A year later, the road behind him is the chart. The other snoozed 1,095 times.

The alarm rang for both of them.

Send this to someone who hits snooze.

#morningroutine #discipline #wakeupearly #selfimprovement #motivation

reels.title: M23 BIR CEKILIS
reels.caption:
This is the night everything changed. 🌙

He put the phone down. Day 30, rain, he falls. Day 95, snow, he keeps going. Day 200, nobody's watching. One year later, the road behind him is the chart.

It all starts with tonight.

Send this to someone on the couch right now.

#selfimprovement #discipline #motivation #habits #mindset
